title: Voice Actors in Cartoons
subtitle: actor → show → character reuse
method_note: Population: cast credited on Animation titles with a voice signal (Wikidata occupation 'voice actor', IMDb characters containing '(voice)', or voice job string). Edges = shared Animation titles (≥2). Gender via TMDB when enriched, else IMDb actor/actress category.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics.

title: Men in Horror
subtitle: gender → role prominence → title profile
method_note: Population: male-coded cast (TMDB gender=male, else IMDb category=actor) credited on Horror movies/series with ≥3 horror titles. Alluvial includes all genders to reveal imbalance. Edges = shared Horror titles (≥2).
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics.

title: Women in Horror
subtitle: gender → role prominence → title profile
method_note: Population: female-coded cast (TMDB gender=female, else IMDb category=actress) with ≥3 Horror credits. Hero = co-appearance on shared Horror titles (≥2). Alluvial includes all genders to show imbalance. Note: gender proxy is imperfect without TMDB enrichment.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics.

title: The Scream-Queen Web
subtitle: actress ↔ actress co-appearance in horror
method_note: Population: female-coded cast with ≥3 Horror credits. Hero = co-appearance web (shared horror titles ≥2). Alluvial: top actresses → era → role band.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics.

title: The Bechdel Web
subtitle: cast across films that pass the Bechdel test
method_note: Population: cast credited on movies that fully pass the Bechdel test (rating=3 on bechdeltest.com; 5,105 titles in cache). Hero = co-appearance among people with ≥3 pass-film credits. Alluvial: gender → Bechdel band (0–3) → era across all rated titles. Bechdel ratings are community-contributed and incomplete — not every film is scored.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics.

title: Comedy × Horror
subtitle: crossover careers between laughs and screams
method_note: Population: people with ≥2 Horror and ≥2 Comedy title credits. Hero = co-appearance among crossover performers. Alluvial: gender → horror/comedy/horror-comedy lane → billing band.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics.

title: Genre Bridges
subtitle: careers spanning two (or more) genres
method_note: Population: actors/actresses with ≥12 title-genre credits whose largest genre is <70% and second genre is ≥20% — careers that meaningfully span genres. Hero = co-appearance; node.bridge shows top two genres.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics.

title: One-Role Wonders
subtitle: person → genre concentration (≥90%)
method_note: Population: actors/actresses with ≥8 title-genre credits whose single largest genre accounts for ≥90% of those credits. Hero links people within the same dominant genre.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics.

title: Long Careers
subtitle: 35+ year credited spans
method_note: Population: actors/actresses with ≥15 credits whose earliest and latest title years span ≥35 years (IMDb startYear). Hero = co-appearance among long-career peers.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics.

title: The Dubbing Multiverse
subtitle: voice actor → character fan-out
method_note: Population: people with a voice signal and ≥5 distinct character credits. Hero = co-appearance among prolific voice performers. Alluvial: top actors → medium → role-count band.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics.
